supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally beyond the orbital margins, terminating near the temporal boundary.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Muzzle area displays lighter grey pixel values with low contrast against the chin, while periocular regions are deeply pigmented/darker.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip visible above the hand.

pinna_silhouette.outer_helix_geometry: Asymmetrical; right ear (viewer's left) apex is rounded, while left ear (viewer's right) apex is angular/pointed.
pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: Possible notch or structural loss on the superior helix of the left ear (viewer's right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Light-colored structural anomaly or notch at the apex of the left ear (viewer's right).
